kuhytrack.budget.why: Tracking without enforcement is just a guilt meter. The budget timer is the only component that turns recorded activity into an action, so kuhytrack with kuhytrack-budget.timer disabled measures the problem and does nothing about it.
kuhytrack.budget.cost_of_bypass: systemctl --user disable kuhytrack-budget.timer. No guard, no audit trail -- which is why this dashboard reports it, since nothing else would.
kuhytrack.budget.ratchet: none -- this is a plain systemd timer with no protection
